climate.source: early-November normals for Columbia, MO (lows ~37 F, highs ~58 F, prevailing SSW wind ~9 mph); used until the forecast file exists (course_data/requests/weather_eagle_knoll.json, from Nov 1)

foot: Tee sets: Back (blue, 6,667, 72.8/134; the NCCGA played the blue tees here in 2015 and 2024), Eagle (gold, back, 6,920, 73.8/141) and Middle (white, 6,186, 70.8/130) are each fully solved from their own boxes; Forward (red, 5,174) moves the Back tee along the line. Card: golfify = OpenGolfAPI (= the NCCGA 2015 sheet). Calm-day picks: 128 prior draws per hole, 512 on the close calls. Photo: USDA NAIP 2020 (0.6 m, the sharpest year available here; no 0.3 m year covers the course); the map was checked on NAIP 2020 / 2022 and the 2015 3DEP lidar. Start time and starting hole are adjustable (default 9:00 shotgun on hole 1; the NCCGA lists 9:00 am both days, tee sheet not yet posted).

hole_notes.3: forced carry over the wooded ravine and the pond to a fairway that starts ~185 yds out (Back) and bends right toward the green; woods left all the way.
hole_notes.5: woods left beyond the cart path the whole way (grown in since the 2015 lidar); woods right 0-10 yds off the fairway.
hole_notes.9: unmown grass right beyond the cart path from ~280; trees right 150-280.
hole_notes.11: a strip of unmown grass left (175-305 from Back), trees right 220-285 beyond the cart path.
hole_notes.14: the pond crosses the line ~200-260 yds out in front of the green: lay up short of ~200 or carry ~265.
hole_notes.17: the creek runs down the left at 140-240 and then crosses diagonally 240-345 yds from Back between the two fairways; woods right.
hole_notes.18: house lots / OB 45-70 yds left; trees right 240-340 beyond the cart path.
